def kernel(r: Float[Array, '16']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    bprobe_v0 = np.empty_like(r)
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v0))
    y = bprobe_v0
    alpha = -r[0]
    beta = 1.0
    y[0] = -r[0]
    for k in range(1, r.shape[0]):
        beta *= 1.0 - alpha * alpha
        bprobe_v1 = r[:k]
        bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v1))
        bprobe_v2 = np.flip(bprobe_v1)
        bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v2))
        bprobe_v3 = y[:k]
        bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v3))
        alpha = -(r[k] + np.dot(bprobe_v2, bprobe_v3)) / beta
        bprobe_v4 = y[:k]
        bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v4))
        bprobe_v5 = np.flip(bprobe_v4)
        bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v5))
        bprobe_v6 = alpha * bprobe_v5
        bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v6))
        y[:k] += bprobe_v6
        y[k] = alpha
    return bprobe_trace
